title: Result Manifest
description: BR-A0.3 draft — output contract for Benchmark Runner runs. Reuses the R3 Q3 shape (run_id, corpus, queries[] with top_k, eligible_set, timing_ms, timing_scope) and adds metrics summary, reproducibility flags, environment, and per-query topology annotations. R3 artifacts (baseline/cassandra/ydb/pg v1) validate as-is: all additions are optional. Schema becomes immutable at Week-2 freeze; this draft is version 0.2.0-draft.

corpus.description: Corpus identifier as recorded by the emitter (R3 shape keeps the plain string; structured cas: refs arrive with the manifest-driven runner).

manifest_id.description: Benchmark Manifest that produced this run (BR-A0.2). Absent on pre-runner R3 artifacts.

composition_id.description: Composition evaluated (BR-A0.2 slug). Absent on pre-runner R3 artifacts.

metrics_summary.description: Run-level metric rollups (recall@k, overlap, latency percentiles, index size...). Absent on R3 artifacts.

reproducibility.description: Reproducibility flags. Absent on R3 artifacts.

environment.description: Lightweight env record (engine + runner versions, model ids/dims, topology). Full digests parked (BR-A0.1 4b). Absent on R3 artifacts.

topology.description: Per-query execution topology (btree_sort, ivfflat, milvus_gpu, ...). Required on runner-produced artifacts; absent on R3 artifacts.
